title: kanban: a board grouped by a lookup or user field draws [object Object] lanes holding every card
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36370 (PR #36411, kanban gets its own view settings). The live run found it; filed by the seat. Parent: #36370.

## What happens

A board grouped by a lookup, user, master_detail or tree field draws wrong. Picking 负责人 (`owner_id`) draws 12 lanes titled "[object Object]", each holding all 12 cards. `ObjectKanban#effectiveColumns` builds lanes from field options, else from `String(record[groupBy])`, and an expanded lookup is an object. Lane bucketing and the per-lane queries key on that string. An authored lookup `groupByField` hits this today; #36411's picker offers only option-backed fields to keep it one click further away.

## To do

1. Lanes from the distinct values of the reference field, titled by the referenced record's name.
2. Bucket cards by the foreign key, and run each lane's query on the key.
3. A drag between lanes writes the foreign key.
4. Then offer these field types in the lane-field picker.

## Acceptance

- A board grouped by owner shows one lane per owner with that owner's cards; dragging a card to another lane changes its owner.

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui. Broken for an authored lookup lane field.
